rationale: Both Jia Jin and Dhanush Gowda have deep roots in developer tools and infrastructure—Jia as a founder building automation systems at NimbleRx (YC W15), and Dhanush as a product manager who previously built training infrastructure at Geektrust. intro_message: Jia Jin, meet Dhanush Gowda — he's a product manager with strong infrastructure and developer tools experience from Geektrust, and you both share a focus on building robust technical systems.
